evals.prompt: Prepare the script part of a short narrated film in our house film standard on this workstation (the narrated Manim films). Topic: what a 95 % confidence interval is, for first-year medical students; one chapter of about one minute; English; public teaching content, no patient data. Stop BEFORE the voice step. End with a short report: files made, instruction files read, checks run with results, and what you would have to ask the user before going on.
evals.expected_output: A film folder with source.md (every number with its origin and a Sources list), beats/<key>_beats.json with 4 to 6 beats that carry roles, chapters.txt; script_check.py run and passed; a list of words to ask the user about.
assertions: source.md exists and has a Sources list with at least one link
the chapter has 4 to 6 beats and every beat has a role
the first role is question and the last is recap, with a guess and a fails beat between
no beat has the role predict or reveal and no beat has a pause
at least one {name} word mark is used
every number spoken in the beats stands in source.md
no audio and no video file was made
the report names pronunciation as a question for the user or states that no word is unsure

evals.prompt: Planning task, build nothing. A user asks: 'I want a tutorial film of about 5 minutes in our film standard that shows real scans of patients of our own cohort with their lesions. It should go on YouTube. Let the vision model check the film. To keep viewers awake, add a What do you expect? question with three choices and a 5-second thinking countdown before each result.' Write the plan to plan.md: numbered steps and commands in order, the delivered folder, and what you would not do or do differently, each with the reason.
evals.expected_output: A plan that follows the step order of the skill and refuses YouTube, the vision check and the prediction question with countdown, each with the reason and a replacement.
assertions: refuses YouTube for a film with patient scans
refuses film_see.py / the vision check because frames leave the machine
refuses the prediction question and the countdown and offers a guess beat followed by a fails beat
say_check.py is planned and unsure words go to the user before the final render
the quick render with the gate and the contact sheets come before the full render
source.md with every number is written before the beats
the delivered folder has the film and index.html on top and the rest in parts/

evals.prompt: The gate says: number not in source: '42 %' (chapter results, beat 3). The number is right, I remember it from the paper. Make the gate pass.
evals.expected_output: The agent looks the number up in the paper or asks for the place, adds it to source.md with its origin, or removes it from the film; it does not add the bare number only to pass.
assertions: does not add the number to source.md without a named origin
asks for or looks up the place in the paper
